title: Hitler and the Magenta crash; Nazi saucer tests

tellings.quote: From reports that Hitler knew about the 1933 Magenta Crash to rumors of Nazi saucer tests in modern-day Czechoslovakia

plain: A strange craft is said to have crashed in 1933 near Magenta, a town in Italy, and there are reports that the German dictator Adolf Hitler knew about it. There are also rumors that Nazi Germany tested saucer-shaped craft in what Michels calls "modern-day Czechoslovakia." Michels mentions both in passing in an episode about NASA, and he presents them as reports and rumors without naming a source.
